title: 第十六章 买一送二第十七章 西凉公主们
content_zh:
韩紫枫淡定的拍着北空明的胸口说：“准备结婚吧，等结完婚我就跑，既然西凉公主来到这里给我添堵，那么我去西凉仗剑江湖，应该没啥问题把？仗剑天涯酒剑仙，策马沙场万骨仇。不比宅斗刺激多啦，费那个心思，逗闷子干嘛？”
北空明一个踉跄，这个想法很上官，毕竟，上官武，也是这个性子，有空跟官场逗闷子，拿着剑，一顿傻，他不香吗？
紫枫淡定的再来一句：“我咋就不信，那个破公主能以一国为嫁妆，求取大国皇子，真把自己当个人物啦。”
北空明淡定递刀说：“行啊，你来拿一国给自己当嫁妆啊！”
紫枫嫌弃说：“就现在的马，一两年一个来回，现实吗？”
北空明再次补刀：“所以，你是想过的吧？是吧？”
紫枫淡定的点头：“确实想过，就是暂时，时间不容许。”一群人再次无语。西凉公主是五天后到的，包括紫枫都被要求到皇宫吃席。紫枫超级好心情的，去折磨御厨啦，让他们变着花样的，叫他们做美食。
别说加上霖华仙尊的暗箱操作，很快厨师弄出披萨、牛排、火锅、烤肉、烤鸭等，都是后世的稀罕玩意儿，足够欺负现在的那些老古董啦，嘿嘿嘿。
再说，西凉公主进城，那个排场啊，是真的够大，紫枫也不多想，看着白莲花系统商城的，她开心买一本弹指神通，更是买看一本御剑术，还赖着霖华仙尊，把炼药壶给重新炼制一下，变成一个酒葫芦。
新的炼妖壶直接被改为造化壶，不但能凝出灵液，也能凝出灵酒，甚至可以储物。霖华仙尊对于这个越玩越跑偏的体验员，直接附赠一把灵剑清风，外带一匹天马，随便这个孩子玩吧。
商城的东西，是买了就能会的，紫枫开心的捡石头，照着西凉公主的车，就开始丢石头，三个石头下来，西凉公主的车就已经裂啦，只是把，叫所有人都深深疑惑的是这个西凉公主的动作，居然是孕味十足。
怎么说呢？她半倚在车上，手爱抚的摸着肚子，满眼的兴奋，紫枫想想冲着一旁的北空明说：“叫御医看看，你别喜当爹。这西凉是欺负咱们没人了吗？”
北空明脸也很黑，如果真是喜当爹，那么西凉真的不用留啦。看了热闹，他们就马上家走，回皇宫，毕竟，西凉公主已经点名北空明，所以作为亲家，上官武也是要过来的。
紫枫和这个西凉公主是前后脚进入皇宫的，西凉公主很有礼貌的给皇帝见礼：“西凉公主图娜青巴，见过大凛陛下。”她用的是抱胸礼，可紫枫看她不顺眼啊，一个石头，照着她的膝盖就打过去。
她没好气的说：“西凉人都这么没礼数吗？见到皇帝要下跪，这种礼数都不知道吗？愚民啊。”
图娜青巴不善的看着紫枫问：“你是什么人？敢对本宫如此无礼，你见本宫也要下跪行礼。”
紫枫也不惯着，上来照着图娜青巴就是一个嘴巴，淡定的回答：“三皇子妃，你个妾，哪来的勇气噬主？子啊说，你当我家皇帝是死的？这里是大凛，你丫的异国公主，哪来的自信穷嘚瑟？跪你，你配吗？还有，皇家血脉是皇家血脉，你想入府是没问题，先交御医切个脉，总不能替别的国家，养野孩子吧？不行就照着肚子来两拳，保证没残留，看这货也是公主的份上，留也就留呗，反正异国公主，留不留子嗣什么的，也没那么重要不是？”
图娜青巴气氛的说：“你也太善妒了吧？”
紫枫回答：“那关你屁事？你个妾，敢来当妾，就必须做好被正室报复的准备好吧？这是智商问题，别告诉我你们是母系社会，滥教不是母系社会的合理理由，咱大凛还真不惜的要破鞋。”
她说完，还不忘问：“系统，你能扫描下，这个货肚子里有娃没？”

霖华仙尊很无语，不过还是说：“双胞胎。”
她不忘补刀：“亲，你就不能加一个扫描功能？大体是就跟神念扫视差不多，每个系统都可以有，你可以参照机械世界的那种，直接扫描出基础属性，怀孕，病症之类问题，应该对你们这样的仙尊，没啥难度吧？”
霖华仙尊能说啥：“好主意，魔改中。”
紫枫看着图娜青巴说：“啧啧啧，双胞胎呢，你妹西凉是多看不起大凛皇室？买一送二，皇帝啊，这种倒贴的破鞋，真心没法当妻吧？妾都是您大度啊！西凉是真瞧不上咱大凛，这是多怕您老断子绝孙啊，居然附赠孕妇和亲，皇帝啊，不行就灭了这个不开眼的破国家吧，他们完全是恶心人啊！”
皇帝也被气到了，真就叫御医过来把脉，结果，至少有娃是可以确定的，保底三个月，这就无线尴尬啦。甚至连和亲的使节，那都尴尬的不要不要的。
紫枫嘲笑：“皇帝啊，这是叫咱大凛给他们养孩子啊，这是意图不轨啊，就这样的，当妾都是多月的吧，好歹是和亲，买一送二是什么鬼？皇帝啊，您老人家的脸被人家踩在地上摩擦，摩擦，并且一次不够两次，两次不够三次，你真的能忍？人家这个王妃，是您同意的吧？叫咱降个级，我是真没问题，您老脸挂得住？关键是替别人养野孩子，还是当皇储的养法，这是要不动用一兵一卒，名正言顺的吧咱大凛更名啊，其心可诛啊。”
使节也不敢了，这个锅是真心不能背啊，会死人的啊。可紫枫是惯着人的人吗？显然不是啊。使节说：“这位姑娘，金殿之上怎可信口雌黄？”
紫枫直接接：“你也知道欺君罔上昂，那还废什么话，拖出去砍了，头寄回去呗，你们西凉敢做初一，咱杀个来使很正常吧？把这个不要脸的公主，肚子刨开，让他们皇帝看看，自家公主是个多不要脸的。你们都赤果果的来谋算我们的国家啦，还惯着你们当我们傻是吧？在咱们这边，你家公主这种，是要被沉塘，浸猪笼的。呸，呸，呸。”
content_en:
Han Zifeng patted Beikong Ming's chest calmly and said: "Get ready to get married. I will run away after the wedding. Since the Princess of Xiliang is here to cause trouble for me, then there should be no problem for me to go to Xiliang to fight with swords and swords in the rivers and lakes. Fighting swords at the end of the world, wine and swordsmen, and riding horses to the battlefield to make enemies. It's not much more exciting than a house fight. Why bother teasing me?"
Beikong Ming staggered. This idea was very Shangguan. After all, Shangguan Wu also had the same temperament. When he had time to fool around with the officialdom, he would hold a sword and make fools. Isn't he cool?
Zifeng said calmly: "I don't believe it. That shabby princess can use a country as a dowry to beg the prince of a big country. She really thinks of herself as a person."
Beikong Ming calmly handed over the knife and said: "Okay, you come and get a country as your dowry!"
Zifeng said in disgust: "The current horses go back and forth every one or two years. Is it realistic?"
Beikong Ming struck again: "So, you have thought about it, right?"
Zifeng nodded calmly: "I have indeed thought about it, but it is temporary and time does not allow it." The group of people was speechless again. Princess Xiliang arrived five days later, and everyone including Zifeng was asked to have a meal at the palace. Zifeng was in a good mood and went to torture the imperial chefs, asking them to cook delicious food in various ways.
Not to mention Linhua Immortal's secret operation, the chef soon came up with pizza, steak, hot pot, barbecue, roast duck, etc., which are all rare things of later generations, enough to bully those old antiques nowadays, hehehe.
Besides, when Princess Xiliang entered the city, the pomp was really big enough. Zifeng didn't think much about it. Looking at the White Lotus System Mall, she happily bought a book on Magical Powers and even a book on Sword Control. She also relied on Immortal Linhua to refining the alchemy pot and turned it into a wine gourd.
The new Demon Refining Pot is directly transformed into a Creation Pot, which can not only condense spiritual liquid, but also spiritual wine, and can even store items. Lin Hua Xianzun directly gave the experiencer a Spirit Sword Qingfeng and a Pegasus to play with as he went astray.
Things in the mall can be learned after buying them. Zifeng happily picked up stones and started throwing stones at Princess Xiliang's car. After three stones fell, Princess Xiliang's car was already cracked. But what made everyone deeply puzzled was that Princess Xiliang's movements were full of pregnancy.
How to say it? She was half leaning on the car, her hands caressing her belly, her eyes full of excitement. Zifeng thought about it and said to Beikong Ming on the side: "Ask the imperial doctor to take a look, you don't want to be a father. Is this Xiliang bullying us?"
Beikong Ming's face is also very dark. If he really wants to be a father, then Xiliang really doesn't need to keep him. After seeing the excitement, they immediately left home and returned to the palace. After all, Princess Xiliang had named Beikong Ming, so as an in-law, Shangguan Wu was also coming.
Zifeng and Princess Xiliang entered the palace front and back. Princess Xiliang politely greeted the emperor: "Princess Xiliang Tuna Qingba, I have met His Majesty Dalin." She used a chest-hugging ceremony, but Zifeng didn't like her, so he hit her on the knee with a stone.
She said angrily: "Are all people in Xiliang so rude? You have to kneel down when you see the emperor. Don't you know this kind of etiquette? You are stupid people."
Tuna Qingba looked at Zifeng unkindly and asked: "Who are you? If you dare to be so rude to me, you must kneel down and salute me when you see me."
Zifeng was not used to it. He came up and looked at Tuna Qingba and replied calmly: "Third prince, you concubine, where did you get the courage to devour the master? Zi ah said, you are dead to think of my emperor? This is Dalin, your exotic princess, where did you get the confidence? Kneel down, you Is it worthy? Also, the royal blood is royal blood. If you want to enter the palace, it's okay. You can't raise a wild child for another country, right? If it doesn't work, just punch it in the stomach and make sure there is no residue. It's for the sake of the princess, so just keep it. Anyway, it's a foreign princess., whether to leave heirs or not is not that important, right? "
Tuna Qingba said angrily: "Are you too jealous? "
Zifeng replied: "That's none of your business? You concubine, if you dare to be a concubine, you must be prepared to be retaliated by your wife, right? This is a matter of IQ. Don't tell me that you are a matriarchal society. Abuse of education is not a reasonable reason for a matriarchal society. We Dalin really don't hesitate to break our shoes. "
After she finished speaking, she did not forget to ask: "System, can you scan to see if there is a baby in this guy's belly? "
Immortal Linhua was speechless, but he still said: "Twins. "
She did not forget to touch up: "Dear, can't you add a scanning function? It's roughly the same as a spiritual scan. Every system can have it. You can refer to the one in the mechanical world and directly scan out basic attributes, pregnancy, diseases and other issues. It shouldn't be difficult for immortals like you, right? "
What can Immortal Linhua say: "Good idea, the magic reform is in progress. "
Zifeng looked at Tuna Qingba and said, "Tsk, tsk, tsk, where are the twins? How much does your sister Xiliang look down on the Dalin royal family? Buy one, get two free, my emperor, you really can’t be a wife with such shabby shoes, right? Concubine, you are so generous! Xiliang really looks down on us, Dalin. They are so afraid that you will die of children and grandchildren, so you actually give a pregnant woman a hand in marriage. Emperor, if that doesn’t work, just destroy this blind and corrupt country. They are completely disgusting people! "
The emperor was also so angry that he actually asked the imperial doctor to come over and check his pulse. As a result, it was at least certain that he would have a baby, with a guarantee of three months, which was extremely embarrassing. Even the envoys who made peace with each other were so embarrassed that they didn't want to do it.
Zifeng laughed: "Emperor, you are asking me, Dalin, to raise a child for them. This is an evil intention. That's it. You only have to be a concubine for many months. After all, it is a marriage. What the hell is buy one, get two free?" Emperor, your old man's face is stepped on the ground and rubbed, rubbed, once not twice, twice not three times, can you really bear it? Do you agree with this princess, right? I really have no problem asking us to downgrade. How can you stand it? The key is to raise wild children for others, or to raise them as a crown prince. This is to do it without using a single soldier. It is just and justified. Let's change the name of Dalin. His heart is to be punished. "
The envoy didn't dare to do it anymore. He really couldn't bear the blame, as it would kill people. But is Zifeng a spoiled person? Obviously not. The envoy said: "How can this girl be trusted to speak licentiously in the Golden Palace? "
Zifeng answered directly: "You also know that bullying a king is a crime, so what nonsense are you talking about? Just drag him out, chop him off, and send the head back. If you Xiliang dare to be the first graders of junior high school, is it normal for us to kill you?" Cut open the belly of this shameless princess and let the emperor see how shameless his princess is. You are all out to plot against our country, and you are still used to treating us as fools, right? In our area, princesses like yours will be drowned in ponds and pig cages. Bah, bah, bah. "
